decision_rationale: The record describes CellWhisperer as a multimodal AI model for scRNA-seq exploration and says it was fine-tuned with conversations about transcriptomes and cell states. It also shows large-scale paired transcriptome-text training and an LLM-powered chat interface, which supports foundation-model-like breadth.
evidence_snippet: fine-tuned the Mistral 7B LLM with conversations about transcriptomes and cell states; a multimodal AI model that combines transcriptome profiles with an understanding of biological text and an LLM-powered chat interface
